verdict.rationale: Qodo documents a dedicated 'Chat with Qodo' feature for interacting with it directly inside pull requests [qodo-docs-23]. It also lets developers discuss or dismiss a finding, or have Qodo apply the fix, which covers the questions, explanations, and commands parts of the story [qodo-docs-3]. Manual triggering of reviews on a PR is supported as well [qodo-docs-26]. Missing for 10: detail on how replies in review threads use the surrounding finding/code context, documentation of the available in-thread commands, and independent or hands-on corroboration that conversational replies work well.
